translations.web: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
translations.bsb: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
translations.kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
translations.asv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.
